notes: The shelter does not give short-term or court-ordered community service hours. It will verify school hours only after you have volunteered at least 3 months. Seats are limited and a missed orientation can be rescheduled only once.
name: Shelter Volunteer (ages 16 and up)
what_you_do: Help care for shelter animals: socialize dogs and cats, walk dogs, do housekeeping or laundry, greet visitors, and help at events and education programs.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and up volunteer on their own. Ages 8 to 15 can volunteer only with a parent or guardian (21 or older) who stays with them. Everyone must attend an orientation.
pay_detail: Unpaid. A one-time program fee is due at sign-up: $30 for ages 16 and up, $15 for ages 8 to 15 (covers t-shirt and badge, non-refundable).
duration: Ongoing shifts. Shelter volunteer hours: 12 to 7 p.m. Monday to Friday, 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturday.
deadline_text: Next orientations: Nov 10 (5:30 to 7:30 p.m.) and Nov 20 (2 to 4 p.m.), 2026. Registration opens Oct 12. A Dec 8 orientation opens Nov 2.
how_to_apply: Pre-register for an orientation on the shelter website and pay the fee. Then book each shift in the volunteer portal before you come in.
